rationale: Both share a refined dark/cream serif art direction with staged hero entrances; A's scroll-driven exploded view of the speaker is a strong storytelling device, but its later sections drift toward generic cards and a pale placeholder-looking response chart. B offers more varied scroll choreography (an orange spec marquee, scrubbed text reveal, pinned zoom-ins on the light ring, knit and oak foot, an interactive room-calibration panel) and its hero builds atmosphere as the speaker materialises and the ring glows on. B's hover states give clear fills, whereas A's are mostly faint shadows or underlines. A's phone layout is slightly cleaner; on B the floating 'Pause motion / Replay intro' pill covers content and is cut off at the right edge.
